messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 429s observed on /v1/generate across us-west-2 tiered gateway. 5m error rate spike to 9.8% (baseline 0.6%). Auto-escalation to #eng-oncall. thread_ts=1853456789

alice: saw the bot, I'm on it. pulling the 5m window on the 429 dashboard now.

brian: I'm paged, joining. which tenants are driving this?

alice: quick glance - top contributors are: tenant-alpha (40%), tenant-botfarm (22%), longtail of small tenants making up the rest.

carol: any 503s too? could be upstream model timeouts.

alice: 503s are flat at 0.3% — this looks rate-limit / quota stepping rather than model crashes. 429 spike correlated with bursty token generation from long sequences.

david: tagging runbook: https://console.redwood/ops/runbooks/ratecap-surge (copy for reference). Suggest surgical ratecap on non-prod and low-SLA tenants first.

alice: agreed. plan: 1) immediate temporary quota reduction for tenant-botfarm (burst->sustained), 2) enable per-tenant burst shaping, 3) disable embeddings as a last resort for noisy tenants, 4) monitor 429/latency panels and SLO error budgets.

eve: can we apply a quick rule? I can push a temporary policy:
```
# curl example to update tenant policy
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/tenants/tenant-botfarm/policy \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"burst_tokens":2000,"sustained_tps":3,"priority":"low"}'
```

frank: while eve does that I'll spin up a kata to patch the global rate limiter to prefer per-tenant fairness for next 30m.

alice: doing tenant-botfarm policy change now. executing the curl.

alice: (after) policy applied — burst 2000 -> sustained 3tps. ops console shows policy version v2026-03-15T15:08.

brian: I pushed a selective shaping rule to drop/queue requests scoring > 100 in cost-estimate header for free-tier tenants. Rule id: shaping-7f2.

carol: adding a dashboard annotation for actions taken:
- 15:08 tenant-botfarm quota change
- 15:10 shaping-7f2 applied

incident-bot: annotation recorded on dashboard at 1853456890.

alice: immediate metrics: 429 rate dropped from 9.8% -> 6.1% in 2m. Not enough yet.

frank: I'm enabling per-tenant prefix-KV caching for older models to reduce token churn (non-invasive). toggling for tenant-alpha as experiment.

frank: cache toggle done for tenant-alpha; cache hit improved for common prompts. 429s reduce another ~1.4%.

brian: still seeing a persistent tail around 4-5% — I suspect long-running streaming sessions still hammering. Any heavy streams we can transiently disable?

alice: we can flip 'streaming=lite' for free-tier which buffers for 250ms and falls back to chunked. I'll flip it for tenants with >10 concurrent streams.

alice: command to flip:
```
POST /admin/featureflags/streaming-lite
body: {"scope":"free-tier","enabled":true,"ttl":1800}
```

eve: applied streaming-lite for free-tier at 15:15.

carol: monitoring panels: latency p95 unchanged (good), 429 trending down to 2.1% after these changes.

david: good. we should prepare a short customer-impact note for support + account managers: list affected tenants, actions taken, expected next steps. I'll draft.

alice: draft to support: "We observed elevated 429s starting 15:02 UTC affecting primarily tenant-alpha and tenant-botfarm. We've applied temporary quota reductions, per-tenant shaping, and toggled streaming-lite for free-tier. 429 rate reduced from 9.8% -> 2.1%. We're continuing to monitor; next update in 30m. No model downtime or data loss."

brian: please include mitigation flags in the message and note the rollback plan (revert policies once 429<0.5% sustained for 15m).

alice: noted. support msg updated and posted to #support-ops.

incident-bot: auto-paging: next on-call in 30m is carol. Will escalate if error_rate > 3% for 10m.

carol: I'll take first handoff if it doesn't reach steady state. For now monitoring and ready to accept escalation.

eve: small observation: tenant-botfarm's traffic is mostly embeddings endpoint calls batched by a single client. we've restricted embeddings for that tenant (embeddings=false) as a stopgap.

frank: embeddings disabled for tenant-botfarm at 15:23 — immediate drop in token churn. 429 at 0.9% now.

alice: sweet. let's keep these mitigations for 20-30 minutes then roll back gradually. telemetry and dashboard will dictate.

david: create a follow-up ticket for infra team to look at improving per-tenant token accounting and prevent single-tenant misreports. I'll make a Jira: RINF-5234.

brian: reminder: capture exact policy versions and IDs in the postmortem: v2026-03-15T15:08, shaping-7f2, featureflag-streaming-lite-v1.

alice: I'm handing off to carol at 15:30. leaving notes in thread. carol, if you need escalation, call me. :phone:

carol: got it. I'll monitor 429 for the next 45m and escalate if it creeps above 3% again. thanks team. :thumbsup:

ops-rotation-bot: oncall_handoff: alice -> carol at 1853457000.

incident-bot: incident provisional severity: Sev3 (service degraded). If we need customer-facing incident report escalate to Sev2.

carol: updating the incident tracker with actions and measurements. Will add a closure note when 429 < 0.5% for 30m.

alice: one more note: prevent automatic quota re-ups for 1h to avoid bounce. I added a hold tag on tenant-botfarm.

frank: logging snapshot exported to /var/artifacts/incident-1853456789/logs.tar.gz for postmortem.

carol: received. closing my active watch. will post final update when conditions met.

incident-bot: resolved condition: 429 rate < 0.5% for 30m recorded at 1853457049. Auto-close waiting for manual confirmation.

carol: confirming resolution at 1853457050. closing incident thread. final note: mitigations rolled back gradually starting +40m after stable checks, no customer data impact.
